identityContext.statement: The author's name was Mary Somerville. As biographical identity context outside the 1827–1831 writing episode, her late recollection records losing her husband in Florence on June 26, 1860; her daughter describes his death after a three-day illness. Identity is supported by the title; the later family-loss context is probable recollection and is not narrated as an event in this episode.

sourceRefs.locator: Title page, Personal Recollections, from Early Life to Old Age, of Mary Somerville.
Chapter XVI, pp. 325–326, I lost my husband in Florence on the 26th June, 1860 through after only three days' illness.
